news.headline: Miller was questionable ahead of the meeting with Kansas City due to hip and back injuries. However, the wideout is good
news.detail: Miller was questionable ahead of the meeting with Kansas City due to hip and back injuries. However, the wideout is good to go. With Caleb Douglas (ankle) ruled out, Miller, who had a touchdown in Week 2 against the 49ers, could be more involved.

profile: role: WR6 rotational — 6% of targets, 12% of snaps.
